I. Basic Business Knowledge 
 
1. What is ITCC? 
ITCC is the abbreviation of Integrated Turbo Compressor Control. This concept first appeared in the 
early 1990s and was proposed by Woodward Company. Triconex (Schneider-Invensys) was successfully 
promoted in the market. The characteristics of Triconex are that it integrates the speed control, surge 
control, interlock protection and auxiliary system monitoring related to compressor control into one system. 
Therefore, a reliable and stable hardware platform which is convenient for maintenance and fault inquiry 
is provided for users. 
2. What is CCS? 
CCS is the abbreviation of English Compressor Control System, which means compressor control 
system. It is the official name widely accepted for compressor control system in the world. CCS is usually 
used in international bidding specifications. 
3. What is SIS? 
SIS is the abbreviation of Safety Instruments System, which is mainly used for safety interlocking 
protection in the plant, such as interlocking shutdown system ESD, fire and gas protection system FGS, 
etc. The system used for SIS needs safety certification, and the internationally recognized certification 
organization is the German TUV safety certification system. 
4. What is the difference between CCS and SIS? 
CCS is a special system for turbine compressor control, with special control software such as surge 
control, speed control and performance control. CCS is dynamically and continuously adjusted during 
operation. SIS system is used for safety interlocking protection, mainly interlocking logic, without special 
control application software. The SIS is normally static and triggers only during hazardous conditions. In 
China's petrochemical industry, SIS hardware platform is usually used for the control of large process 
compressors, and sometimes a set of hardware platform is shared, but in most cases, CCS is an 
independent system. In non-petroleum and petrochemical applications requiring safety level, such as the 
compressor control system of air compressor widely used in steel industry, power industry, metal mining 
industry and machinery manufacturing industry, safety certification is not required, and PLC and special 
controller can be used for CCS. Even in the petroleum and petrochemical industry, the CCS system of the 
air compressor for plant power air and instrument air does not need to use the SIS system platform. The 
interlock shutdown function, ESD, is included in the CCS. This is why the SIS platform is widely used for 
CCS in the petrochemical industry. 
5. What is TMC? 
TMC is the abbreviation of Turbo Machinery Control, which means turbomachinery control and is 
usually used as a general term for the turbomachinery control industry. Turbine machinery includes: 
steam turbine (steam turbine), gas turbine (gas turbine), expander (catalytic flue gas turbine, LNG 

 
3 
 
nitrogen turbine, tail gas expander in PTA, etc.), centrifugal compressor and axial compressor. In fact, an 
aircraft engine is a kind of turbomachinery, that is, a gas turbine. 
6. What is a turbo compressor? 
According to the working principle, the compressor is mainly divided into two categories: one is the 
positive-displacement compressor; the other is the turbine compressor. The positive displacement 
compressor compresses gas by changing the internal volume of the compressor, such as an inflator. 
Positive displacement compressors are divided into compound compressors, screw compressors and 
diaphragm compressors. The typical application is the new hydrogen compressor of the hydrogenation 
unit in the refinery.There are also two types of turbine compressors: one is the centrifugal compressor, 
whose working principle is to pressurize the gas by centrifugal force. Most of the process gas 
compressors used in petrochemical plants are centrifugal compressors, such as the rich gas compressor 
of the catalytic unit, the recycle hydrogen compressor of the hydrogenation unit, and the cracked gas 
compressor of the ethylene plant; The other is the axial-flow compressor, whose working principle is to 
use the principle of airflow lift of aircraft wings to pressurize the gas, and its representative is the main fan 
of the catalytic unit in the refinery.

7. What are the special controls of the compressor control system CCS? 
Special control applications such as surge control, turbine speed control, performance control, and 
expander control. 
8. What is compressor surge? 
Surge is a unique phenomenon of turbo compressor. We can explain this characteristic from the 
simple model in the figure below. It can be seen from the figure that when the pressure in the container 
reaches a certain value, the operating point of the compressor rises from D along the performance curve 
to the surge point A, the flow decreases and the pressure increases. In this process, the flow decreases 
and the pressure increases. From point A to point B, the compressor has a negative flow, that is, backflow 
occurs. When the backflow reaches a certain degree, the compressor outlet pressure decreases (B-C).? 
Return to forward flow (C-D). In this way, the airflow flowing back and forth in the compressor is surge, 
which is accompanied by the sharp rise of compressor vibration and the huge abnormal sound similar to 
asthma patients. If it cannot be effectively controlled, it will cause serious damage to the compressor, 
such as the damage of dry gas seal and rotor impeller. In severe cases, all the blades of the axial 
compressor will be broken.The development of surge condition is very fast, generally within 1-3 seconds, 
so accurate control algorithm and fast controller are needed to control effectively.

6. What are the advantages of the CCS optimized control solution for 
central control? 
1. Ensure stable operation of unit and process in case of process disturbance 
At present, most of the compressors are operated manually. When the process fluctuates greatly or 
the unstable working conditions occur during the start-up process, the manual operation can not 
automatically adjust and track the process changes in time, which will lead to the instability of the process 
or even shutdown. The performance control of the central control unit control technology can be linked to 
the process, thus stabilizing the compressor and process operation and avoiding unnecessary shutdown. 
 
2. Energy saving and consumption reduction 
At present, many compressors with general control system are running with manual control and large 
opening of the anti-surge valve, resulting in increased energy consumption. The compressor control 
technology of central control is more accurate, which can greatly reduce or close the anti-surge valve, and 
the performance control automatically adjusts the compressor load, so that the energy consumption is 
reduced by about 10-15% on average compared with the ordinary control. 
 
3. Fully automatic control 
The staffing of large petrochemical plants in the world is very streamlined. For example, the average 
number of people in refineries with a scale of 10 million to 20 million tons abroad does not exceed 1000. 

 
11 
 
Therefore, compressor posts are not equipped with operators, and process posts are taken into account. 
At the same time, manual operation requires more attention and experience of operators, but there are 
still problems such as device shutdown and compressor surge caused by misoperation.Especially in the 
start-up stage of new plant, due to the lack of experience of operators, process fluctuation, mismatch of 
process equipment and other issues, manual start-up will prolong the whole start-up process.The 
compressor optimization control technology of the central control solves this problem very well. The 
professional performance control and surge control have special algorithms to provide the functions of 
automatic start, loading and automatic shutdown, so that the unit can start and run without manual 
intervention of the operator, the device can run faster and more smoothly, and the torch emission during 
the start-up process can be minimized or the torch can be eliminated. 
 
 
7. How to operate the CCS project of energy-saving renovation? 
1. Which units have the opportunity of energy-saving optimization and transformation? 
The more complex the process and the more the number of compressor sections, the greater 
the chance of energy-saving transformation. For example, catalytic rich gas compressor, coking rich 
gas compressor and reforming booster in oil refinery; ammonia refrigeration, CO2 compressor and 
synthesis gas compressor in fertilizer plant; refrigeration compressor, CO2 compressor, synthesis 
gas compressor and air compressor in coal chemical industry; cracking gas compressor and 
ethylene propylene refrigeration compressor in ethylene plant; blast furnace fan in steel industry, etc.; 
Most of the anti-surge valves of these units can not be closed and have a large opening, resulting in 
energy waste. 
Another major category is the multi-unit air compressor group, such as instrument power wind in 
the petroleum and petrochemical industry, air separation in the steel industry, etc. There are many 
devices providing compressor air that use multiple units in parallel operation. Such multi-unit group

Overview 
The T5100 Compressor Control System (CCS) is built on the SUPCON PLC product GCS-G5 and the 
supCCS compressor optimization control solution. Designed for centrifugal and axial flow compressors 
in process industries, it offers high cost-effectiveness, flexibility, and proven reliability. The T5100 system 
is particularly suitable for compressor control applications in non-explosive environments such as air 
compression and transportation where the drive unit may be a steam turbine, electric motor, or gas 
turbine. 
The T5100 system features excellent environmental adaptability so it caters to the specific needs of 
users in different application fields. With G3 anti-corrosion technology, it is ideal for applications requiring 
corrosion resistance, wide temperature ranges, high altitudes, explosion-proof and outdoor use. It 
demonstrates long-term reliability in environments ranging from -40ºC to 80ºC. 
The supCCS solution is independently developed by SUPCON based on its decades of industry 
experience. With a core concept of safety, energy saving and full automation, it is a professional control 
algorithm and solution for centrifugal and axial compressor units in the petroleum and chemical 
industries, including steam-driven, electric-driven and fuel-driven large turbine machinery. The 
successful cases of numerous unit control projects in recent years have fully demonstrated the 
advanced technologies and maturity of the supCCS solution.

As the core unit of the T5100 system, the TCU521-S 
provides functions such as data acquisition and processing, 
and output control. The controller is connected to the SCNet 
(operator station, engineer station) via the Unified Control 
Protocol (UCP). It receives management information from 
the upper layers while uploading characteristic data and real-
time data channels. Meanwhile, it periodically collects real-
time field process data from the signal input modules, 
process the data with user-defined algorithms, and outputs 
signals to achieve real-time object control in the field.

tasks, periodic tasks and event tasks.

adjacent redundancy

➢ Performs configuration consistency check during operation. 
➢ Supports offline and online configuration updates, saves complete configuration archives to the 
controller, and the configuration can be uploaded. 
➢ Allows for access from master devices to the controller's open memory through the MODBUS RTU 
slave interface. 
➢ The local bus supports up to 4 racks and can connect up to 32 I/O modules. 
➢ The remote bus supports up to 31 remote I/O nodes, and each node can be connected to up to 8 
I/O modules.

The on-site surge test provided by the supCCS solution can effectively expand the actual operating 
space of the compressor for users, contributing to safe, energy-saving and fully automatic compressor 
control and operation.

second. In such a fast surge test process, the compressor is very safe, and no actual changes can be 
seen in the shaft system measurement parameters.

Overview 
The T9100 Compressor Control System is independently developed by SUPCON as a part of TCS-900 
Safety Instrumented System (SIS). It is an enhanced control system for centrifugal and axial 
compressors in petrochemical and chemical industries where drives such as steam turbines, gas 
turbines and motors are used. The T9100 is particularly suitable for the control and protection of 
compressors in hazardous areas. 
The TCS-900 system is a triple modular redundant (TMR) fault-tolerant SIS certified by TüV 
Rheinland to SIL3. It is widely used in the following applications in the petrochemical, chemical and 
power industries:

supCCS Surge Test 
The on-site surge test provided by the supCCS solution can effectively expand the actual operating 
space of the compressor for users, contributing to safe, energy-saving and fully automatic compressor 
control and operation. 
A real on-site surge test shows that within one control cycle, the T9100 system detects a rapid airflow 
drop in the compressor and quickly opens the anti-surge valve by one degree, and stabilizes after one 
second. In such a fast surge test process, the compressor is very safe, and no actual changes can be 
seen in the shaft system measurement parameters.

G5Pro Overview
Features
System Network
SUPCON G5Pro is a fully-redundant medium-to-large size highly 
reliable programmable logic control system. The control system 
adopts a uniﬁed UCP communication protocol to realize seamless 
compatibility of data interaction between GCS series control 
systems. Through hardware full-redundant system design and 
diagnostic coverage of over 90%, G5Pro ensures reliability and 
availability for ﬁeld applications. The rich industry function library 
and open conﬁguration of G5Pro can be widely applied in various 
ﬁelds such as long-distance oil and gas pipelines, railway BAS, 
tunnel environmental control, water conservancy monitoring, 
comprehensive pipe corridors, sewage treatment, clean water 
supply, and other municipal engineering ﬁelds.
High-reliability design
All modules support hot-swapping with power, and the entire 
series of components and networks support redundant mode;
Support accurate monitoring of over 10 running statuses such as 
controller temperature, CPU usage, with diagnostic coverage of 
over 90%;
Own the breakpoint resume capability. When the network is 
interrupted, the data can be stored locally. After the network is 
recovered.
High-performance and large-capacity design
32-bit processor with a clock frequency of 1 GHz and a system 
memory of 1.5 GB, including 8 MB program memory and 2 MB 
data memory.
A single controller can support the connection of 512 IO 
modules.
Adopts a structure of "one network to the end" ，all 
communication rates are above 100 Mbps. The controller 
supports up to 1000 Mbps.
Built-in information security
Adopt control + network dual core design, supporting network 
information security and the most secure and reliable ﬁeld 
control simultaneously.Product components support universal 
encryption algorithms, such as RSA and AES.
Open data interface
Support communication protocols such as Modbus RTU/Modbus 
TCP, PROFINET, DNP3, OPC, etc.
High environmental adaptability
Own industrial-grade wide-temperature capability (-20~70℃), 
G3 anti-corrosion, and EMC third-level anti-electromagnetic 
interference.
The G5Pro system has great ﬂexibility in network connection and expansion, which 
can meet the application requirements of diﬀerent network sites.  
The G5Pro system supports a maximum of 32 remote racks, with a single rack 
supporting 16 I/O modules and an overall maximum of 512 expandable remote I/O 
modules.
The system communication of G5Pro adopts multiple bus compatibility and 
heterogeneous system integration modes; The local/remote bus of the system 
supports 100Mbps Ethernet connection.

high-density and distributed applications. It renders robust 
performances as a small scale and stand-alone control system even 
in   a narrow space. It is compatible with SUPCON GCS series PLC, 
and can be seamlessly   connected to GCS G3 and GCS G5. It can also 
be used as a remote IO module of the     G5Pro controller for remote 
extension, contributing to a high cost-performance ratio.   It is 
widely applied in the process industries, including petrochemical, 
ﬁne chemical,     oil and gas exploration, municipal engineering, 
metallurgy, pharmaceutical, etc.
Designed in compliance with the international industrial standards 
and speciﬁcations, the G3Smart system ensures high availability, 
reliability and openness,   and boasts the following distinctive 
features:
Support multiple communication protocols: UCP, Proﬁnet, Proﬁbus DP,  
Modbus-RTU, Modbus-TCP, OPC protocol-supported external communication   
interfaces, so as to realize communication with other control systems or smart 
device.
Flexible and diverse control functions
Multi-task operating system, to support Multi-task mode such as 
Initiating Task, Periodic Task, Cyclic Task and Event Task
User-friendly conﬁguration environment

topologies
Open data interface
Support Modbus RTU/Modbus TCP, PROFINET, DNP3, OPC and

High environmental adaptability
Industrial-grade components, support the working range of

X-Ray Fluorescence 
The C-QUAND has a powerful 
15-watt, 50 kV X-Ray source, with 
a silver anode. The X-Rays displace 
the inner electron from the K or L 
orbit of the atom, leaving a void. 
The now unstable atom will imme-
diately fill the void with an electron 
from the outer orbits. The resulting 
reduction in energy is emitted as a 
photon with a specific energy level 
unique to that element. The fluores-
cence is captured by a silicon drift 
detector (SDD). It’s count rate being 
monitored directly proportional to 
the concentration of the element.
Measuring Cell
The X-rays generated by the source 
are first filtered by one of six dif-
ferent optical filters, dependent 
on the application. The X-rays con-
tinue through a thin window before 
hitting actual sample. The window 
is made from Beryllium for Sulfur 
measurement in hydrocarbons, or 
a polyimide such as Kapton® or 
Upilex® for the measurement of 
metals in aqueous and corrosive 
solutions. By means of the refer-
ence metal in the measuring cell, 
automatic gain validation and cali-
bration is done, avoiding drift with-
out requiring a single human action. 
The heated sample cell & flow path 
can operate at a temperature up to 
80ºC (176ºF) avoiding precipitation.

Principle of Operation 
The C-QUAND analyzer is designed to continuously measure multiple ele-
ments starting from silicon (Z=14) from ppm levels upwards, in liquid samples. 
It uses energy Dispersive X-Ray Fluorescence (ED-XRF) technology, to measure 
the characteristic X-Rays generated by the atoms in the sample. 

Operational aspects of the C-Quand 
Turnkey solutions
The key to success of on-line XRF analysis is the sample 
system. A well-designed sample system will ensure max-
imum measurement availability. With over 40 years of 
experience, Hobré Instruments has unique proprietary 
solutions for challenging environments, such as highly 
corrosive liquids and samples with high and abrasive 
particle load. Our in- house XRF laboratory is happy to 
review your specific application.
Intuitive and low-maintenance operation
The analysis method used by the C-QUAND is a direct 
measurement without the need for sample preparation 
or conversion reactions. It does not require additional 
chemicals or buffers that continually need to be replaced 
and it has no problematic moving parts or sources of 
blockage. 
The special coated sample cell window, minimizes con-
tamination, allowing longer periods of operation without 
maintenance. 
Process trends are displayed on the HMI and are remotely 
accessible through Modbus via RS485 or TCP/IP, both for 
the client and (with client’ permission) Hobré for support 
and maintenance purposes. 
100% Reliable measurement
With the C-QUAND you are equipped with an analyzer 
that gives you truly reliable and validated results, without 
human intervention. The analyzer is standard equipped 
with a fully automated gain validation and correction 
mechanism. For applications that require the measure-
ment of light elements, in low concentrations (e.g. Sulfur 
in ULSG and ULSD) or that are prone to fouling/drift, the 
C-QUAND PLUS is available. The C-QUAND PLUS encom-
passes a fully automated cell-flushing, and zero & span 
validation + correction system. 
Simple Calibration
As depicted in below graph, the C-QUAND has a very 
linear response. In the example a Sulfur analyzer is cali-
brated using a blank and a 1000 ppm standard measur-
ing samples of 10, 20 and 100 ppm.

Principle of Operation 
The Hobré Raman can simultaneously measure C1..C5+, N2, H2, CO2 in gases. 
Technologically wise, the Hobré Raman is a big step forward as it offers a com-
bination of features not available in any other analyzer on the market, e.g.:
•	 High accuracy compositional analysis in 10 seconds,
•	 No moving parts, 
•	 Full separation of detector and electronics, 
•	 Wide concentration range,

•	 Lowest lag time and nearly zero dead volume, 
•	 Suitable for high pressure application, without the need for pressure reduction,

•	 Hydrogen measurement as a standard (0-100% range) makes it “future proof”, 
•	 Output of physical properties like heating value, Wobbe Index, density, 
specific gravity, heat ratio Cp/Cv, compressibility, air demand.
In corporation with TNO (the Netherlands Organization for applied scientific research) in Delft, Hobré developed a 
very robust and innovative, patented Raman technology for online gas analysis in the oil and gas industry, including 
renewables. With the Raman technology Hobré offers a fast responding gas composition analysis for feed forward 
control on high- and low-pressure applications. The combination between the Hobré Raman technology and 
Hobré’s proprietary HIFISC probe design results in an unmatched Zero-Emission setup.

FEATURES
Technology
The analysis is based on the Raman 
measurement principle and named 
after its discoverer, the physicist 
C.V. Raman. Raman spectroscopy is 
a nondestructive, fast responding 
measurement principle that pro-
vides chemical information on the 
sample being analyzed. This tech-
nique allows users to obtain (near) 
real time information on the com-
position as well as physical proper-
ties which can be used to optimize 
efficiency based on a feedforward 
control loop.
Light interacts with materials in dif-
ferent ways (transmitting, reflect-
ing or scattering). Raman looks at 
scattered light. A continuous wave 
type laser is focused into a mea-
suring cell through a spherical lens. 
The scattered light is detected by 
a spectrometer. Most of the light 
that scatters remain unchanged in 
energy (Rayleigh Scattered). A small 
fraction of the scattered light will 
lose or gain energy. This fraction is 
referred to as Raman scattering. 

1.	No need to reduce the pressure (which would require 
heated regulators).
2.	Sample is returned to process, eliminating the need 
for large fast loop flows and venting to atmosphere or 
flare. 
3.	The probe design allows for the shortest possible lag 
time and a nearly zero dead volume. 
Hobré offers the Raman analyzer in combination with 
the HIFISC sample technology. The differential pressure 
over the probe tip of the HIFISC probe, drives a fast loop 
over a multiphobic filter element. A small amount of sam-
ple is guided through the measuring cell for analysis. The 
complete sample flow is returned to process.
The change in energy depends on the vibration frequency 
of the molecule. Light atoms have strong bonds and a 
high frequency, resulting in a significant change in energy. 
Heavy elements (low frequency, weak bonds) show a 
small change in energy. The energy difference between 
the two states is unique and can be used for both identifi-
cation of an element and quantitative analysis.

The TISOMIC can simultane ously measure H2S,

it offers a combination of features not available 
in any other analyzer on the market. Its key fea-

Hobré started working with the company Hilase Kft. in 2009, introducing the very robust and innova-
tive photo acoustic technology in process analyzers for measurement of on-line H2S, H2O and CO2 in 
gas and liquid streams in the highly demanding oil and gas industry. The acquisition of Hobré Laser 
Technology Kft in January 2014 has further strengthened and combined the unique expertise and 
technology of both companies.  
The TISOMIC, with PA-TDL technology, is a proven and virtually maintenance-free online process ana-
lyzer used in a wide variety of applications and monitor levels at all stages. Featuring a 10cm path length 
cell which is heated and temperature-controlled, with no need for multi-pass mirrors. It is suitable for appli-
cations ranging from H2S in well fluids, through separation and treatment, to sales gas and oil quality con-
trol.
Principle of Operation 
Technology
The analysis is based on the photo acoustic 
measurement principle. This technology has 
been developed to fully utilize the high precision 
of modern Tunable Diode Lasers (TDL), low-
noise, 
of 
cutting-edge 
acoustic 
amplifiers 
and 
high-quality 
microphones. 
Different 
components are excited by tuning the laser 
diode to corresponding absorption and specific 
background wavelengths. The TDL’s output 
power is modulated to the resonance frequency 
of the measurement cell. The modulation of 
the excitation level of the medium generates 
linear pressure waves corresponding with the 
concentration of the specific components. The 
pressure wave is amplified by the resonance
chamber and measured as sound by the 
microphone. Background noise is removed 
by custom-designed acoustic mufflers and a 
secondary microphone dedicated to background 
filtering. The signal is amplified a second time 
by the acoustic amplifiers and is processed. As 
the TISOMIC does not use optical detection, the 
analysis is not sensitive to contamination or 
fouling.
 
Features
Close to zero maintenance, combined with ab-
sence of moving parts, ensures high availability. 
A high level of self diagnostics allows mainte-
nance on demand and improves reliability. 
Multiple photo acoustic cells and/or dual lasers 
in a single analyzer allow simultaneous analysis 
of different components  (H2S, H2O, CO2) and mul-
ti-stream monitoring (e.g. before and after sepa-
rators). 
When used with a well-designed sample system, 
such as the Hobré HIFISC, the Hobré TISOMIC can 
run with a drift of typically less than 3% over a 
year. Automatic validation or manual calibration 
is required just once every few months. Designed 
to be maintenance-free for over five years, with 
power as its only utility, its cost of ownership is 
the lowest on the market.

Introduction

H2S and H2O are reactive components, often present at low ppm levels. The measurement capabi-
lities of the analyzer are only beneficial when it is used with a well-designed sample conditioning 
system. Since 1978 Hobré Instruments has experience in the design and supply of such systems. Our 
designs are application-specific, based on the gas composition, the phase diagram of the process 
fluids and process upset conditions.
To overcome excessive time lags between the sample probe inlet and analyzer due to the volume of 
probe, block and bleed valves and sample lines, as well as liquid carry-over problems, Hobré Instru-
ments has developed the HIFISC Modular Sampling System.
The HIFISC system features an advanced combination of components and provides sa-
fety through full double block and bleed process isolation, superior response time, 
accuracy, low emissions, low maintenance and high availability and reliability. For trace levels of

Gas Applications
For low ppm H2S applications Hobré uses a concept with two measuring cells in series. The first cell is used on process gas and 
the second on reference gas that comes from the scrubber. To ensure identical physical behavior through both cells a ‘dummy’ 
scrubber filled with glass beads is used for the process gas stream. The percentage of scrubber saturation is determined by 
the analyzer and is designed for a lifetime of at least six months. Applying this differential measurement on a continuous basis, 
offers the possibility of trending the background variations without compromising on the measurement itself.
The software of the Exi terminal is designed in such a way 
that we can configure the unit for each application: single 
stream, multi stream or multi component. Control of two Hobré 
TISOMIC analyzers with a single Exi terminal is also a possi-

WIM COMPASTM  RANGE

The continuous measurement principle is 
designed for maximum performance in terms of 
response time and repeatability. 
A small sample flow is mixed continuously with 
dry air over critical orifices. The air–fuel mixture 
is combusted in a catalytic oven and the residual 
oxygen is measured using a reliable, highly accu-
rate zirconia cell. The residual oxygen is a direct 
measure for the CARI and correlates well to the 
Wobbe Index. 
The WIM COMPAS™ adds to Hobré’s portfolio of process analyzers for measuring Wobbe Index, 
Heating Value/BTU, Combustion Air Requirement Index (CARI), Air Demand, Specific Gravity and 
Mol Weight. The Wobbe Index and/or Heating Value are critical parameters used to optimize 
blending and combustion processes. Designed and manufactured in-house, the WIM COMPAS™ 
builds on Hobré’s experience with residual oxygen type analyzers. The analyzer is considered a 
market leader in the oil & gas industry. 
As of 1 January 2018, the WIM COMPASTM F has been divided in four sub-models. Based on our 30+ 
years of experience with the WIM COMPASTM with an installed base of +1000 units, a set of fixed 
configurations have been defined. The main differentiator is the configuration type, in order to 
provide our customers a more standardized product with more focus on each specific application 
field. 
The technology of the WIM COMPAS™ is based on the measurement of the amount of air required for 
the complete combustion of sample gas. This method is referred to in ASTM D4891-13 and ISO 15971. 
Depending on the task, Hobré can offer a continuous (fast-responding) unit or an injection version, 
which is capable of handling the most challenging applications.
Introduction
Principle of Operation
The injection measurement principle offers 
a robust solution to the measurement of even 
the most challenging gas samples, such as 
sour gas and flare gas. 
The measurement is based on the injection of 
very small amounts of gas samples at low pres-
sure in a constant instrument air flow. The 
amount of oxygen required for the combus-
tion correlates directly to the Heating Value of 
the sample.

The WIM COMPASTM Range
The WIM COMPASTM Xpress analyzer was intro-
duced specifically for Natural gas/LNG applications. 
The Xpress operates according the continuous 
measurement principle, and is configured for 
one-point calibration. The analyzer is designed for 
maximum performance in terms of response time, 
repeatability and availability. It measures Wobbe 
index and CARI as a standard. Optionally a Specific 
Gravity cell can be included for additional outputs 
such as Heating Value, Air Demand, Mol Weight 
and Specific Gravity. The analyzer is suitable for in-
stallation in Safe area, ATEX zone 1, IECEx or Class 1 
Div 2.
The Xpress analyzer is configured for Zero hydro-
carbon emission as a standard, as venting of hydro-
carbons into atmosphere is undesired as well as 
unwanted due to stricter emission regulation.

The WIM COMPASTM Pulse operates accord-

This model offers a robust solution for diffi-

The measurement is based on the injection

The Pulse can be configured for various haz-

Operation, service and maintenance 
Protected against sun and rain, this robust analyzer is suit-
able for outdoor installation in a harsh industrial environ-
ment. The periodically required calibration can be performed 
manually or automatically on a timed interval. Generally, the 
calibration gases last many years. The analyzer only has a 
few parts that require regular servicing, and it is designed for 
safe and easy maintenance.

Operation, service and maintenance
Hydrogen measurement
The WIM COMPASTM for flare gas analysis and recovery is the 
preferred technology at supermajor refineries because of its 
proven trackrecord in challenging applications. The analyzer 
can handle applications with high H2 fluctuations (0-100 mol%) 
and non-combustibles such as N2, CO2. By using the High Tem-
perature (HT) version the WIM COMPAS™ can be kept above 
dew point of the gas (max. 150°C/300°F)   
Optionally the WIM COMPAS™ can directly measure the H2 
concentration of flare gas, in accordance with 40 CFR 63.670 
section J. The integrated H2 measurement, FEH2 (Frontal Elution 
Hydrogen Measurement), enables the operator to use the so 
called “H2 credit” to increase the BTU of the flare vent gas direct-
ly. This will improve compliance even more and allow customers 
to save on assist gas.
The WIM COMPASTM  Gas Stabilization System creates a con-
stant furnace atmosphere by stabilizing the Wobbe Index of 
fuel gas, using compressed air or another auxiliary gas.
The system continuously monitors the mixing ratio of incoming 
natural gas and injected air. The ratio itself is controlled by 
the WIM COMPASTM analyzer. In this way the integrated WIM 
COMPASTM Wobbe Index analyzer ensures a very constant 
gas quality and rapid variations in gas demand can be dealt 
with safely. Typical application fields are steel and glass 
manufacturing. 
Gas Stabilization System
With worldwide increasing focus on emission control, compa-
nies are placing a higher importance on monitoring flue gases 
coming from their processes before being released into the at-
mosphere. Regulations are captured in directives such as EU-
ETS and US-EPA.
Hobré combines Wobbe Index/Heating Value/BTU measure-
ment with CO2 or SO2 emission monitoring by coupling the WIM 
COMPASTM  with a Stand-alone analyzer. This also enables the 
use of a single sample take-off and sample handling system.

[slide 1] InPlant Defender Pro  One Page Introduction Solution Positioning and Application Scenarios What is it Main Products and Business Scenarios What to Sell InPlant Defender Pro is an industrial host protection software featuring program allowlist protection, network allowlist protection, virus scan and removal, mandatory access control (MAC), security baseline, secure USB drive, patch management, group immunity, and dynamic integrity measurement. The allowlist mechanism is used to intercept the execution of all unknown programs and scripts, and the blocklist protection mechanism is used to strengthen the allowlist security. In this way, virus and Trojan infection and zero-day vulnerability exploitation can be effectively prevented, and security can be ensured for industrial hosts including engineer stations, operator stations, SCADA servers, database servers, and OPC servers in the industrial environment. In addition, the software also offers centralized management of the ICS Security Management Platform, featuring remote configuration, system patch update and virus database update to improve work efficiency of industrial sites. Program Allowlist Protection A allowlist file suitable for the current industrial host is generated through disk scanning, software installation tracking, and built-in allowlist library, to identify and block the operation of any program that is not in the allowlist. Blocklist Protection Before the files are added to the program allowlist, virus scanning can be performed to identify risks in files. Files that pass security verification are added to the host allowlist file to ensure the safe and stable operation of equipment such as engineer stations, operator stations, and servers. Dynamic Behavior Analysis Based on a Virtual Sandbox When scanning, the virus killing engine will perform the controlled virtual execution in the virtual sandbox, so as to realize dynamic analysis techniques such as peeling and behavior analysis. Network Allowlist Protection Network allowlist protection featuring "port + program" is supported, to prevent access of networks that do not use trusted ports or programs ,  effectively resisting network attacks. Mandatory Access Control BLP and BIBA models help formulate read and write access policies for subjects (processes) and objects (files) with different defined security levels in different models, ensuring system confidentiality and integrity. Security Baseline According to the security configuration requirements of various components such as operating systems, applications, and network devices, a series of security baselines are formulated to harden industrial hosts and realize security compliance.  Secure USB Drive USB portable storage devices are subject to strict control. In case of emergencies, secure USB drives can be employed to access industrial hosts, effectively eliminating the possibility of malicious code infecting them.  Patch Management The software can access to the ICS Security Management Platform, realizing one-click download and installation of Windows patches that have passed compatibility verification. Group Immunity When any client discovers and detects a virus, a security policy against the virus is deployed on all clients through ICS Security Management Platform. Dynamic Measurement It monitors critical execution processes, files, registries, shared libraries, network communications, and data integrity within the industrial host in real time, to continuously measure the security of execution environments. With scenario-based software behavior baseline policies, it analyzes the security of industrial environments, detects abnormal software behavior promptly, thus safeguarding against malicious programs like viruses, trojans, and unauthorized software. Centralized Management Centralized management is available for the ICS Security Management Platform featuring running status monitoring of all InPlant Defender Pros in the network, one-key distribution of configuration, software/virus database upgrade, and log audit and analysis.
[slide 2] SALES TIPS InPlant Defender Pro products are sold based on an one-time purchase model. The updates of the built-in anti-virus databases are provided free of charge on a six-month cycle during the warranty period. and large-scale industrial network hierarchical management scenarios.

Centralized Management

of multiple SUPCON industrial information security products, including VxDefenderPro, 
Industrial Firewall,Industrial Data Diode, Network Diagnostic Platform, and Industrial Network 
Security Monitoring And Auditing System.

Risk Status Monitoring
Risk assessment is available for evaluating the asset value, vulnerability, and threats. The asset 
risk value is calculated based on the risk calculation model. In this way, the asset risk ranking 
is provided, and the current asset security status is displayed.
Distributed Deployment
Multiple ICS Security Management Platforms can be centrally managed using the Industrial 
Security Supervisor Platform, ensuring unified management of industrial security products 
across network segments and equipment sets.
Unified Configuration

Herd Immunity

VxDefenderPro
Product Overview
VxDefenderPro is an industrial host protection software featuring program allowlist pro-
tection, network allowlist protection, virus scan and removal, mandatory access control 
(MAC), security baseline, secure USB drive, patch management, group immunity, and 
dynamic integrity measurement. The allowlist mechanism is used to intercept the execu-
tion of all unknown programs and scripts, and the blocklist protection mechanism is used 
to strengthen the allowlist security. In this way, virus and Trojan infection and zero-day 
vulnerability exploitation can be effectively prevented, and security can be ensured for 
industrial hosts including engineer stations, operator stations, SCADA servers, database 
servers, and OPC servers in the industrial environment. In addition, the software also offers 
centralized management of the ICS Security Management Platform, featuring remote con-
figuration, system patch update and virus database update to improve work efficiency of 
industrial sites.

Program Allowlist Protection
A allowlist file suitable for the current industrial host is generated through disk scanning, software installation tracking, and built-in 
allowlist library, to identify and block the operation of any program that is not in the allowlist
Product Advantages
Blocklist Protection
Before the files are added to the program allowlist, virus scanning can be performed to identify risks in files. Files that pass security 
verification are added to the host allowlist file to ensure the safe and stable operation of equipment such as engineer stations, 
operator stations, and servers
Dynamic Behavior Analysis Based on a Virtual Sandbox
When scanning, the virus killing engine will perform the controlled virtual execution in the virtual sandbox, so as to realize dynamic 
analysis techniques such as peeling and behavior analysis
Network Allowlist Protection
Network allowlist protection featuring "port + program" is supported, to prevent access of networks that do not use trusted 
ports or programs. This effectively resists various network attacks
Mandatory Access Control
BLP and BIBA models help formulate read and write access policies for subjects (processes) and objects (files) with different defined 
security levels in different models, ensuring system confidentiality and integrity
Security Baseline
According to the security configuration requirements of various components such as operating systems, applications, and network 
devices, a series of security baselines are formulated to harden industrial hosts and realize security compliance
Secure USB Drive
USB portable storage devices are subject to strict control. In case of emergencies, secure USB drives can be employed to access 
industrial hosts, effectively eliminating the possibility of malicious code infecting them
Patch Management
The software can access to the ICS Security Management Platform, realizing one-click download and installation of Windows patches 
that have passed compatibility verification
Group Immunity
When any client discovers and detects a virus, a security policy against the virus is deployed on all clients through ICS Security 
Management Platform
Dynamic Measurement
It monitors critical execution processes, files, registries, shared libraries, network communications, and data integrity within the 
industrial host in real time, to continuously measure the security of execution environments. With scenario-based software behavior 
baseline policies, it analyzes the security of industrial environments, detects abnormal software behavior promptly, thus safeguarding 
against malicious programs like viruses, trojans, and unauthorized software
Centralized Management
Centralized management is available for the ICS Security Management Platform featuring running status monitoring of all VxDefend-

The USB Guard is a terminal protection product specially designed for comprehensive pro-

built-in file filtering function filters the files in the portable storage device, to conduct virus

dynamic behavior analysis technology based on virtual sandbox has enhanced the ability 
of virus detection and killing.

Allowlist + Blocklist Mode
The USB Guard adopts the dual protection mechanism featuring "Allowlist + Blocklist", with the 
built-in allowlist of file types and antivirus engine:
(1) Only files of the specified types in the allowlist are shared, and all other files are filtered out;
(2) Virus files detected and removed by the antivirus engine will be moved to the quarantine zone;
(3) Allowlist files in the trusted zone will be scanned but not removed

Plug-and-Play
After the USB Guard is powered on, only simple configurations of IP addresses and sharing

segment, with no additional software required on the client
Log Audit
Operations are recorded in details for users to view and audit, including file operations, virus 
scanning and removal, and system configuration of the portable storage device

[slide 1] Intelligent Operation Management  &  Control System (OMC) One-page  Product   Introduction Product  C oncept  & P ositioning What is it? The relationship between OMC, DCS and industrial software: OMC is not a simple  DCS+industrial  software, but a platform-level product that deeply integrates the two. The Intelligent Application Centre serves as a service hub for various industrial software, with the ability to deploy databases and service frameworks for DCS and various types of software (e.g. IDM, AAS, Pilot, APC, etc.).Responsible for managing the start and stop of various application services and the storage of overall data. Data is transmitted between DCS and software through a secure and encrypted soft bus, avoiding the risks and inefficiencies caused by traditional OPC connections. More efficient and safer than traditional models. The intelligent operating station replaces the traditional operator station and multiple software clients, and has a unified account system, engineering configuration permissions and monitoring screen entry. Operators can conveniently monitor the overall operation of the device from a physical computer. OMC versions: OMC is available in Standard, Enhanced, and Advanced  versions . The Standard version encompasses all capabilities of the ECS-700 at a comparable cost and facilitates basic automation functionalities; the Enhanced version supports autonomous operations while enhancing efficiency and reducing consumption; the Advanced version achieves real-time optimization, operational optimization, and scheduling optimization. All the three versions offer seamless upgrades. OMC is mainly responsible for process control, production operation, operation optimization, etc. It is deployed at the L2 and L2.5 layers and is more relevant to user instrumentation, production, and process departments.  Who and how should OMC speak to: OMC  Enhanced & Advanced: talk to the company's middle and senior leaders (general manager, vice president in charge of production and procurement, chief engineer) to discuss cost reduction, efficiency improvement, economic indicators, etc. Strive to  sign a strategic cooperation agreement or guide customers to write the OMC structure into the bidding specification, formulate a technical scoring table, and form a scoring advantage  ; OMC Standard: for users who have very low development aspirations, very small budgets, and only require basic automation. Don't talk to the grassroots instrument manager or workshop director about topics such as less manpower and autonomous operation. What are the advantages of the OMC architecture compared to its competitors: Focusing on the advantages of software + hardware integration, single component capabilities may not be as good as those of  international competitors , but foreign software is developed and maintained independently through the acquisition of subsidiaries, so there is no way to achieve integration technically. Domestic companies do not have such a comprehensive industrial software system as  SUPCON . Most of them are general contractors and agents of software from other manufacturers, which is costly and provides inconsistent services. The position of OMC in the company's PA+BA business structure:
[slide 2] S ales  T arget : OMC is promoted throughout the industry, with petrochemical and chemical industries (multiple subdivisions) as key industries.  The OMC Standard  version  encompasses all capabilities of the ECS-700, including the OMC hardware, platform, and HPHMI component, with costs on par with the ECS-700. The OMC Standard will serve as an upgraded replacement for the ECS-700 system. In scenarios where bids were previously made for the ECS-700 system, use OMC Standard as the replacement during communication, configuration, and selling. For large projects worth tens of millions or more, start the project operations as early as possible and seek support from senior leaders of users . Implant the concept of OMC in advance to increase the bid winning rate, expand the scope of projects, create industry and regional benchmarks, and form a radiating effect. Strive to operate projects worth about 1 million to more than 3 million through the OMC model . S ales  S trateg y : For new projects: All projects must promote OMC. This achieves energy savings, reduces consumption, and enhances quality and efficiency throughout the production process. ProcessOptimization By integrating mechanism models with the DCS and real-time databases, achieve online model calibration and optimization calculations. This integration facilitates closed-loop real-time optimization of the unit in conjunction with APC, supporting efficient operation. SchedulingOptimization By identifying and alerting abnormal operating conditions, automatically diagnosing abnormalities, and modeling quantitative calculations and pushing of scheduling plans, achieve on-demand adjustments, upload and issue scheduling instructions, and automate the execution of schemes.

[slide 1] SMART SITE SOLUTION ONE PAGE INTRODUCTION Solution Positioning and Application Scenarios What is it Main Products and Business Scenarios What to Sell Smart Site  integrates a platform with apps, featuring an IoT module that centrally manages devices like wearables and sensors for seamless data integration. AI edge servers analyze real-time surveillance, quickly detecting safety issues like worker errors and equipment malfunctions using industry-specific algorithms. The Smart Site offers a 3D interactive interface to visualize and mitigate safety risks across personnel, equipment, operations, and the environment. Smart Site  includes apps for personnel tracking, equipment management, intelligent surveillance, 3D mapping, and IoT monitoring, supporting centralized multi-site management. Personnel Safety Management Utilizing an intelligent positioning system, we monitor workers' locations and vitals in real-time for safety. In emergencies, managers quickly locate workers for immediate response. Analyzing positioning data optimizes processes, boosting efficiency. Historical trajectory playback aids in pattern analysis, preventing safety risks and efficiency issues, enhancing the site safety management. Equipment Safety Management The Heavy Equipment Management offers comprehensive lifecycle management for on-site machinery, from entry to exit, allowing users to quickly access and manage equipment data via mobile scanning for efficient oversight. Operation Safety Management Leveraging IoT devices enables real-time hazard detection and prevention on sites, improving safety management efficiency and protecting worker health. Video intelligence technology provides timely monitoring and warnings, quickly identifying and addressing risky behaviors, and supports data-driven decisions to enhance site safety. Environmental Safety Management Deploying a small weather station at the site facilitates the collection, storage, processing, and analysis of environmental data, including dust, noise, and meteorological factors. Integrated into the site management platform, it enables centralized monitoring and utilizes big data for early warnings and predictive analysis of environmental hazards, providing timely decision support for environmental hazard prevention.

Overview
TCS-900 is an advanced safety control system based on TMR (Triple 
Modular Redundancy) 2oo3D technology. The system ensures both 
safety and availability in process industry applications. It has safety 
integrity level 3 certification approved by TÜV Rheinland in compliance 
with IEC 61508 and IEC 61511. The controller endures 3-fault tolerance 
in total when the modules are in redundancy configuration, which 
significantly improves the availability of the system and prevents the 
unexpected trip. With outstanding performance of safety function, 
system diagnosis, data processing, and information integration, the 
system is widely applied in petrochemical, refining, chemical industry, 
oil & gas upstream, turbocompressor, and other process industries.

In a safety instrument loop, the TCS-900 system adopts a TMR architecture, which includes controllers, 
buses, and I/O modules. The processors, power supplies, and buses of each channel are physically 
independent to avoid the impact of a single channel failure. The data of each channel is processed 
through voting to ensure consistency and reliability.
The five-level voting mechanism enhances the system's fault isolation capability, preventing a single fault 
from spreading to the entire channel and thus ensuring that the overall system performance does not 
degrade.

NECESSITY CO DETECTION

Necessity for CO Detection
13
In spray drying we are essentially making a perfect bomb!

Necessity for CO Detection
14
CO Gas released
•
In the drying chamber, liquid is sprayed as droplet form, 
meeting hot air. 
•
During this process, a lump (cake of powder) can be formed. 
•
The inside of these lumps can become very hot under high 
drying temperatures. 
•
These hot-spots are called smolders.

Necessity for CO Detection
15
CO Gas released
•
These lumps are not easily detected with thermal cameras 
because of their low surface temperatures.
•
The smolders eventually grow, using the lump itself as the fuel.
•
Measuring CO is an early warning of this phenomenon!

Necessity for CO Detection
16
•
The smolder becomes a source of ignition either 
by reaching the surface of the lump or by 
breaking apart, exposing the smolder.
Lots of CO released!
Solution to detect dangerous situations early 
is to measure CO (Carbon Monoxide) 
concentrations

Necessity for CO Detection
17
“80% of fires in spray dryers are a result of spontaneous 
combustion, due to a smolder”

Necessity for CO Detection
18
•
As shown in the graph, CO detection is a 
true pre-warning method to detect 
smolders! 
•
Allowing to detect a rise in CO far (up to 
60 min*) before a fire and/or explosion. 
*Above graph is for a dairy product. Not all products produce (equal amounts of) CO

Necessity for CO Detection
19
Vulnerable areas: 
• Spray nozzles
• Chamber roof
• Fluid beds
• Bag filters
Explosion / Fire area
Powder lumps / Hot spots /  Fouling

Necessity for CO Detection

Inlet air 
Exhaust air
•
As ambient air can have high amounts of CO, 
released by trucks, fires, etc. We must measure all 
different inlet streams too. 
•
By doing a differential measurement between the 
various  inlet and exhaust air streams of the spray 
drying installation, the 𝜟𝜟CO is calculated. 
•
Any 𝜟𝜟CO detected, is by definition formed within 
the spray drying installation. Potentially by a 
smolder!

A properly spray dried product must not be:

•
Seasonal variation: summer – winter (up to 24% fluctuations in capacity)

Air temperature
•
Product feedstock

Between dryer outlet air humidity there is an equilibrium with the

•
Thus, between outlet humidity and product humidity, there is a 
correlation – this is reflected in the stickiness curve.  
•
Online dryer humidity measurement = production at optimal stickiness 
point.

23/09/19
Why?
• Refiners are processing a wide range of crude oils of varying quality to 
drive competitiveness. 
• Lower quality crudes: higher levels of Chlorides, Sulphur, Nitrogen, 
metals, tramp amines, solids and acidity. 
• Can drive up corrosion in the crude unit without proper conditioning. 

www.hobre.com
CORROSION MANAGEMENT 
(DESALTER & CRUDE OVERHEAD UNIT)
25
23/09/19
• Corrosion and other issues are caused by chlorides present in the crude oil, both inorganic and 
organic
• Already 20 ppm of chlorides can lead to significant corrosion issues!
• Inorganic chlorides present in crude oil are: NaCl, MgCl2 and CaCl2
• MgCl2 and CaCl2 will partly hydrolyze in the crude distillation unit to form gaseous HCl
• NaCl tends to pass into the atmospheric residue and causes problems in the VDU and 
downstream conversion units
• Organic chlorides originate from upstream oil production chemicals
• Some may decompose and from HCl
• Others end up in the naphtha stream

Measurement Principal
7
1. Gas molecules that absorb radiation, will excite 
to higher (instable) energy state.
.
2. The molecules will immediately fall back to stable 
ground state.
.
3. In this process the absorbed energy will be 
released as collisions between molecules. The 
latter results in temperature increase.
.
4. By modulating the radiation source at an acoustic 
frequency, the temperature changes periodically. 
This results in periodical pressure change.
5. The pressure change can be observed as an 
acoustic signal (=sound) and can be detected by 
a sensitive microphone.

supOS Executive Highlights 
Overview 
supOS is a platform for industrial digital transformation. 
supOS can connect your infrastructure, manage and analyze your data flow, and 
build unlimited applications. 
supOS solution includes industrial IoT, big data and AI, low-code App development, 
covering use cases in digital factory, unified operation center (UOC), safety 
production, EAM, utility efficiency and more. 
 
Core Features 
1. 
Flexible Heterogeneous Data Collection 
supOS provides a unified collection point to realize the access and pre-processing of 
multiple heterogeneous data sources. Data sources supported include: 
• 
A variety of industrial common protocols (300+ protocols): OPC DA/UA, Modbus 
TCP/RTU, BACnet, IEC104, SNMP, RTSP, EPA, HART, PROFINET, etc., by the 
product X-Collector module of supOS to ingest real-time data with DCS/PLC/CNC 
and other systems from mainstream manufacturers (Schneider, ABB, Honeywell, 
etc.), alarm events and video streaming data. 
• 
MQTT/gRPC Gateway 
• 
ODBC/JDBC: Relational Database Access 
• 
Restful API/Web Service 

• 
Kafka, MQ 
• 
Local Resources: Local File Directories. 
• 
Big Data Storage Access: Hive/HBase 
• 
3rd Party System Connector: such as SAP, PI, MES, ERP, OA, SCM, CRM, etc. 
 
The supOS's distributed DataLake offers a unified, single-point-of-source for 
heterogeneous data synchronization, compression, storage and query. 
The X-ETL, supOS's data pipelining tool, can provide functions of data extraction, 
loading, cleaning, filtering, aggregation, conversion and supports flow-based drag-n-
drop task scheduling. 
 
2. 
Object-Oriented Digital Factory Modeling 
• 
supOS adopts object modeling methodology and templates to create a 
comprehensive digital model of factory facilities, such as workshops, equipment, 
process, personnel, products, raw materials, vehicles, and warehouses. 
• 
Object instances can extend object properties, services, events, and subscription 
properties by inheriting templates when they are created. 
 
 
3. 
One-stop Powerful AI/ML Service 

Deploying AI capabilities to realize real-time analysis and event detection based on-
site video (X-Edge computing and algorithm service), multi-variable self-adaptive 
process control, optimization and forecasting with supOS.  
The supOS AI platform supports the following algorithms and features: 
• 
ML/DL: classification, clustering, regression, prediction, optimization, and 
RNN/CNN/BP/LSTM and more deep learning algorithms. 
• 
A drag-and-drop configuration pipeline: modeling, experimenting, evaluating and 
publishing big data algorithms. 
• 
Support importing 3rd-party custom algorithms. 
• 
Supports offline training of AI algorithms and scenarios. 
 
 
4. 
Drag-and-drop, Workflow-based Low-code App Development 
• 
By module of supOS IDE, supOS provides easy-to-use DIY configuration tools 
for visualization and dashboard design. The tools include rich graphical libraries and 
components. 
• 
supOS platform provides a configurable APP development IDE, which effectively 
reduces the IT threshold for business-oriented APP (including Web & Mobile) 
development and design through a graphical, component-based, wizard-style 
environment. 
• 
The platform provides a workflow configuration development environment based 
on BPMN process specification. 

 
5. 
General Functions 
• 
Unified Access: AD Sync, SSO, OIDC/OAuth2, etc. 
• 
Personalized Workbench: Configure as your need 
• 
Authority and Permission Management 
• 
User and Role Management 
• 
Message and Notification Center 
• 
Open API Integration

Reference Cases 
• 
SINOPEC Zhenghai Refinery & Chemical Co. LTD Project 
Our client is a giant Chinese integrated refining and chemical enterprise. We 
integrated 13 heterogeneous systems, including real-time databases, EM systems, 
and measurement systems, with over 60,000 data points.  
We formed a big data platform based on supOS, which consolidates data from all 
instrument and control equipment, including DCS, SIS, CCS, PLC, intelligent 
instruments, equipment inventory, work permits, wagon balance, video, and other 
sources. 
Moreover, we developed machine learning algorithms for predictive maintenance of 
instruments, which include high-frequency fault instrument life prediction, regulating 
valve flow anomaly monitoring, and program-controlled valve internal leakage 
monitoring. 
 

• 
Chambroad Co. LTD Next-Generation Intelligent Factory Project 
Chambroad, a top Chinese petrochemical company with an annual processing 
capacity of 18 million tons, partnered with us to integrate over 100 IT & OT systems 
using supOS, and built up a centralized data lake that can be accessed by 
applications via Open API and standard services.  
This project led to impressive improvements, including a 20% increase in productivity, 
a 30% improvement in project completion rates, and an overall cost savings of $3 
million per year. 
 
• 
Aramco Community Service Project 
supOS cooperated with Aramco Community Service and developed a smart 
community app, myCommunity, which aims to enhance the health and well-being of 
people in Aramco Communities. The goal is to make communities more inclusive, 
interoperable, and resilient through digital and technology services, giving people a 
high sense of social engagement.
